name: lintassist
description: Static site — source lives in public/, copied to dist/ for Cloudflare Pages (project's configured output directory).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist/
scripts.build:marketing: rm -rf marketing-dist && mkdir -p marketing-dist && cp public/marketing.html marketing-dist/index.html && cp public/logo.png public/Logo-Figma.png public/Logo-Google_Chrome_Web_Store.svg.webp public/privacy.html public/releases.html marketing-dist/ && cp seo/marketing-robots.txt marketing-dist/robots.txt && cp seo/marketing-sitemap.xml marketing-dist/sitemap.xml
